claims.value: Pre-trained only model in Hugging Face Transformers format. Intended for fine-tuning, in-context learning, and research. Features a Causal Language Model with Vision Encoder, 2B parameters, and native context length of 262,144 tokens.
claims.evidence: This repository contains model weights and configuration files for the pre-trained only model in the Hugging Face Transformers format. The intended use cases are fine-tuning, in-context learning experiments
Context Length: 262,144 natively and extensible up to 1,010,000 tokens.
